## What it is

Solid Ø36 column on the tower axis, Z 18.7 to 47.0. Its flat bottom stands on the adapter's flat top, placed by a `scale_dowel` pressed into it; it carries the cup grille's seat in a top socket. Weak magnets (two Ø5 x 2) in wells open at the bottom face, strong magnets (two Ø8 x 3) in the top socket's floor. Printed upright as modelled, bottom on the bed. Bambu PETG Basic.

## Design notes

- Modelled in the machine frame and ends with `scale_frame`.
- Lower joint: flat on flat. Well depth = magnet height + `weak_magnet_gap` - adapter magnet recess (0.2) = 2.8 at the default gap of 1.0; the magnet is pushed to the well's end. The parameter defaults to the layout value; raise it to weaken the joint.
- Dowel hole: Ø3.8 (`dowel.tower_hole`, 0.10 under the dowel), 4 mm deep, over the adapter's key hole at (92, 54). A dowel pushed home stands 1 mm proud. One dowel 5 mm off the axis sets the position; the magnet pairs turn the tower into line. The dowel's short, coned engagement lets the tower tip off the weak magnets when the grille is lifted.
- The upper socket is `scale_seat` with the seat height plus the socket clearance (0.5), so its flanks coincide with the grille's boss and its floor stays 0.5 clear.
- Upper joint: wells in the socket floor going down, depth = magnet height (flush), the grille's are flush too, so the pair is 0.5 apart.
- Printed upright: the lower wells and the dowel hole open on the bed, their ends are 5 mm bridges. The bottom socket's 20 mm bridge, pierced by the wells, sagged on the first print; it is gone.
- Plastic: the upper wells are 15 mm clear of the lower ones.
- Lightening is not wanted: solid body, infill makes it light.
- Polish: 1 mm on the outer top rim only. Nothing on the bed face or the sockets.

## Don't

- Do not put a bottom socket back: its ceiling was a 20 mm bridge broken by the well mouths, and it sagged (2026-11-17).
- Do not lengthen the dowel's reach into the adapter: past about 1 mm the tower can only come off straight up the dowel's axis.
- Do not chamfer the socket edges or flanks, nor the bottom face: they mate.
- Do not hollow it out.
- Do not edit the well depth by hand: change `weak_magnet_gap`.
- Do not remove the final `scale_frame`: without it the part prints as its mirror image (found 2026-11-16: the PCB box came out on the wrong side of the cell).

## Changelog

- 2026-11-16 - Ends with `scale_frame` (Y reversed): the machine frame is left-handed, so the part was the mirror image of the real object.
- 2026-11-17 - 2 mm taller (bottom 20.7 -> 18.7): the base's floor went 4 -> 2 mm and the cell came down with it; the top stays under the cup grille.
- 2026-11-17 - Magnet wells at the magnet's nominal diameter (`aimant_puit_press_fit` +0.15 -> 0.0): the +0.15 wells did not hold the magnets at all. On trial.
- 2026-11-17 - Magnet wells +0.10 over the magnet's diameter (`aimant_puit_press_fit` 0.0 -> 0.10): 0.0 was too tight. On trial.
- 2026-11-17 - Bottom socket dropped: flat bottom on the adapter's flat top, placed by a `scale_dowel` (Ø3.8 press-fit hole, 4 deep); weak wells open at the bottom face, 2.8 deep. Height unchanged (bottom still Z 18.7).
